create_ordered_buckets: create a list of partition pair buckets ordered by random, affinity, or layer strategy
create_buckets_by_affinity: create buckets where consecutive pairs share as many partitions as possible to minimize I/O cost
create_buckets_by_layer: create buckets ordered in concentric L-shaped layers from outside-in or inside-out
single_machine_bucket_scheduler: build a single-machine bucket scheduler to acquire and release partition pairs for training
distributed_bucket_scheduler: build a distributed bucket scheduler using a lock server client for multi-worker training
